cover.prompt: On an isolated rocky spur of Mount Phyle severed by a deep chasm, mercenary-1 stands in dramatic theatrical profile with feet planted wide, holding an unrolled papyrus dispatch held out at arm's length, making an urgent, decisive gesture with his other hand clear of his torso; mercenary-3 in oxblood tunic stands opposite with back straight and chin raised in skepticism across a rough stone survey table; a rugged limestone crag and wooden signal tripod anchor the left margin of the frame; across the deep shadowy gorge, the sunlit mountain cliffs and distant sea horizon provide clean silhouette separation and crisp architectural form, with unobstructed morning sky filling the top third of the panel.
cover.others: a signal basket hanging from the tripod.
